Member Directory
Book Awards
The Golden Star Book Awards
Open for Submissions May 12 to July 16
Every August, the Wilbury Writers League honors four members of our group with a Golden
Star Book Award. These awards represent literary excellence in an unpublished fiction
manuscript that has not yet been submitted to an agent. The winners will be awarded in each
of the categories listed below. They will be recognized on our Web site and will meet with a
literary agent currently seeking to represent new and upcoming authors.
Entry Fee per Category $60
Entry Categories
Requirements
Contemporary
Character-driven novel with a strong female protagonist
Historical
Set in the nineteenth century or earlier
Mystery and Detective
Plot-driven novel told from a first-person perspective
Children and Young Adult
Realistic fiction with human protagonists
You can submit manuscripts in multiple categories, but each requires a separate entry fee.
Submit your work at www.wilburywritersleague.org/gsba.
Submission Form
Date: June 10
Author's Name: Jenna Nwadike
E-mail: jennanwadike@worldmail.com
Manuscript Title: The Shipbuilder's Secret
Genre: Historical Fiction
Brief Synopsis:
Free-spirited Aisha spends much of her time combing the beach looking for shells until a
box washes ashore with secrets from the past. Upon opening the box, Aisha is whisked
back to the shipbuilding world of her great-great-grandfather.
Author Biography:
I am a freelance writer and former librarian who has written for over ten years. I write
articles for a local history magazine and have published several short stories for children.
However, my passion is historical fiction. The Shipbuilder's Secret is my first novel.
To:
GSBA entrants
From:
Glenda Ochebe
Date:
August 12
Subject:
Winners of the Golden Star Book Awards
Thank you for submitting your manuscripts for consideration for the Golden Star Book
Awards. We received over 1,000 entries this year, many of outstanding quality.
Congratulations to our winners: Ava Dione (Contemporary), Layla Ahmad (Historical),
Gregory Levine (Mystery and Detective, and Perry Oliver (Children and Young Adult).
Their works impressed our judges and deserve recognition for their literary excellence.
Excerpts of the award-winning titles can be found on the Wilbury Writers League Web
Thanks to everyone who entered our contest. We wish you the best of luck with your
writing and encourage you to consider submitting your work again next year.
Sincerely,
Glenda Ochebe
Special Events Coordinator, Wilbury Writers League
